accessAll.message: Every origin this configuration needs has been granted.

accessMissing.message: Some origins have not been granted yet.

accessNote.message: A redirect needs permission for its destination.

ackBlocks.message: Arming stays unavailable until these are accepted.

addDomainNote.message: Only the domain. How it builds its search URL is picked below, never typed.

catchAllExists.message: There can only be one catch-all.

catchAllInsecure.message: Together: every search shaped like a short key will leave in clear text.

catchAllNote.message: Any 2-to-6-character key followed by a hyphen and a number goes to this destination, on the engines you ticked. A short reserved list is held back.

commandDisarmAll.message: Arm or disarm Jira Quick Jump

diagAllAwaitingAck.message: Every armed shortcut is waiting for a warning to be accepted.

diagAllShadowed.message: Every shortcut sits below the catch-all, so none of them fires.

diagCatchAllNotInstalled.message: The catch-all could not be installed, so it claims nothing.

diagDisarmed.message: Every shortcut is off. Searches behave normally.

diagInstallFailed.message: The rules could not be installed. What is running may differ from what you see.

diagMissingOrigins.message: Rules are installed but cannot fire: access is missing.

diagNoEngines.message: No search engine selected, so no rule can be built.

diagNoShortcuts.message: No shortcut yet, so nothing is intercepted.

diagPartial.message: Some saved entries could not be read back.

diagSomeShadowed.message: Some shortcuts sit below the catch-all and never fire.

enginesNote.message: Only searches from these are rewritten.

extensionDescription.message: Type ABC-1234 in the address bar and land straight on the Jira issue.

factReplaced.message: The whole configuration changed elsewhere. Check every destination.

factShadowed.message: These keys now go to the catch-all:

importDisarmed.message: Everything arrives disarmed, and warnings you accepted before are not carried over.

importDropped.message: Some entries were refused and will not be imported.

importLede.message: Check where each key would send you. A configuration file can point a key you already use at a different server.

importTooBig.message: That file is too large to be a configuration.

installDiffers.message: The installed configuration differs from the one you see.

journalOverflowed.message: Some changes could not be recorded.

noLongerShadowedActive.message: No longer shadowed: this shortcut fires again.

nowShadowed.message: Now shadowed: this shortcut no longer fires.

optionsSub.message: Type an issue key in the address bar, land on the issue.

orderDropped.message: The list changed, so your move was dropped.

orderNote.message: Evaluated from top to bottom. The first match wins.

previewNoMatch.message: This search would go through untouched.

previewNotASearchUrl.message: That is not a search URL.

previewReservedPrefix.message: Held back by a reserved prefix, so the catch-all leaves it alone.

previewTooLong.message: That is too long to be a search URL.

previewTypedHint.message: Paste a search URL, or just the text you would type in the address bar.

quarantineFoot.message: It produces no rule, and it stays here until you decide.

quarantineNote.message: Kept, never deleted on your behalf.

shadowedWhy.message: A line placed below the catch-all never fires, whatever its key. Move it above the catch-all.

storageMovedLocal.message: Your configuration is on this device only, and the synced copy was removed.

storageMovedSync.message: Your configuration now syncs. Copies already on other devices may remain.

storageNote.message: Syncing sends your Jira host names to your browser account.

storageTooBig.message: This configuration is too large to sync.

warnCatchAll.message: Every search shaped like a 2-to-6-character key, a hyphen and a number will leave for this destination, on each engine you ticked. Only a short reserved list is held back.

warnInsecureScheme.message: Traffic and your Jira session cookie travel in clear text.

warnInternalHost.message: This destination is on a private or non-public network.

warnLiteralIp.message: This destination is an IP address rather than a host name.

warnPunycode.message: This host name uses non-ASCII characters and may imitate another one.

previewUnavailable.message: Could not read the installed rules.
